facts.fact: ANP reports the PNDN 2026-2035 document was "remis officiellement" (handed over) to the Minister of Communication on 13 October 2025 by the drafting committee after two months' work; the minister speaks of the policy applying "après son adoption", so no adoption is stated and no adopting act or body is named.

systems.tiers: Described by the committee chair as a national strategic framework to drive and govern the country's digital transformation, with three axes (sector governance and security; digital infrastructure and services; skills and innovation) and an institutional mechanism for coordination, monitoring and evaluation (no body named); the minister says it is to apply across the public administration and eventually the private sector.
